description: verify.vocabulary: the closed sets the gate forms render from — requirement classes, run states, run reasons — the env allowlist's NAMES (what may cross into a gate's environment; credentials are the rule, and the allowlist is its positive half), and the daemon's own statement of what verify.try does, so a client never guesses the semantics of a spawn from its name.

result.tryStatement: verify.try runs the named gate now, in the component's primary root, as the verifier-engineer under the policy gate and a scrubbed environment (the allowlist and the LC* locale family only); the run is recorded as manual with your identity, and the answer names the path it ran in and the loops still active there (a try may race a loop's tree — the response says so, OD8).
